newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's new car sales see April record rise.
newsitem.headline: Italy's new car sales see April record rise.

text.p: New-car sales in Italy rose at a record pace in April as an incentive scheme encouraged more buyers into show rooms after four years of sluggish demand.

The Ministry of Transport reported Friday that April new car registrations rocketed 52 percent to 231,500 and set the Italian market on course to top two million cars this year for the first time since 1992.
"This is a phenomenal figure for April and shows the effects of the incentive scheme," said analyst Bob Barber at HSBC James Capel.
The April rise followed a of 25 percent increase in March and a 21 percent rise in February.

Italy introduced its incentive scheme, funded by the government and industry, in January. Under the plan, car owners receive price discounts on new cars when they trade in cars more than 10 years old.
